daily_summary.headline: SpaceX Starlink Launch Highlights the Day

top_events.title: SpaceX Falcon 9 Launch
top_events.description: SpaceX is set to launch a Falcon 9 Block 5 rocket carrying the Starlink Group 15-15 satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base, California. This mission is part of SpaceX's ongoing efforts to expand its Starlink satellite internet constellation.
top_events.action: Watch live on SpaceX's official webcast.

top_events.title: Aurora Viewing Opportunity
top_events.description: A G1 geomagnetic storm is expected, offering a minor aurora viewing opportunity at higher latitudes.
top_events.action: Check local aurora forecasts for the best viewing times.

top_events.title: Long March 6A Launch
top_events.description: China's Long March 6A rocket is scheduled to launch with an unknown payload from Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center.
top_events.action: Follow updates for more details on the payload.
